_comment: Routes are presentational visitor experiences. They hold no geometry; their member segments remain the only geometry on the map.

Each route entry needs: id, name, segments (an ordered array of walking-trails.geojson ids), optional segment_directions, shape (loop or out-and-back), difficulty (easy, moderate, or rugged), length_ft, elevation gain/loss and profile fields when available, description, and status (provisional or confirmed).
For an out-and-back route, length_ft counts the member segments twice so the displayed distance includes the return trip.
Elevation profile points are [distance_ft, elevation_ft] pairs for the complete route; gain and loss also cover the complete route.
Routes reference segments only. Do not add route membership back onto segment features or merge segment coordinates into route geometry.
